goalsQuestion: What upload volume, concurrent viewers, source sizes, bitrate and playback/readiness timing should I use?
constraintsQuestion: What do upload completion, processing retries, publication, retention and deletion guarantee?
requirementsAnswer: I will size source storage from the agreed upload volume, 250 MB average source and 10-minute duration, and size playback bandwidth from peak concurrent viewers and 3 Mbps; I target p95 playback start below 2 seconds and 99 percent readiness within 10 minutes of completed upload.
coreExplanation: The video API checks creator access, assigns a stable video and upload ID, verifies durable source bytes before acknowledging completion, and records recoverable processing work with uploading, processing, ready or failed status; upload success alone never claims playback readiness.

A processing worker owns an expiring lease, produces versioned 720p and 1080p outputs where supported, and publishes the playback manifest and ready metadata only after all required output objects are complete; repeated processing uses the same logical job and cannot publish another video.
validationExplanation: For playback a viewer loads a versioned manifest and short seekable segments through the CDN, selects a lower bitrate when bandwidth falls, and reads only segments around a requested seek position; I would load-test a hot video and measure p95 startup, rebuffer time and origin traffic.

If processing fails halfway through I recover from the durable source and retry incomplete work with a bounded job policy while keeping partial outputs hidden; I would monitor processing backlog, the 10-minute readiness target and egress cost, and test deletion that blocks new playback at origin and CDN within 60 seconds without claiming to recall buffered bytes.
weakAnswer: I call every upload ready before processing, let retry jobs publish conflicting partial outputs, make viewers download the whole video before seeking, and keep deleted playback URLs usable forever.
reviewFocus: Durable source acceptance and playable readiness are different states.
Retries need coherent publication rather than duplicate or incomplete playback outputs.
Whole-video download before seeking and perpetual deleted URLs contradict the playback and deletion requirements.
